title: A message down the pipe
summary: pipe, fork, close the unused ends, write and read.
hints: `int p[2]; pipe(p);` BEFORE the `fork`. `p[0]` is the end you read from, `p[1]` the end you write to.
Each process closes the end it does not use. Put a `'\0'` after what `read` gave you before printing it as a string.
